# Tabitha Khadse — Engineering Case Studies Hub

> Engineering project portfolio by frontend-focused software engineer Tabitha Khadse. Covers responsive frontends, browser QA, synthetic healthcare dashboards, AI engineering experiments and workflow automation.

## Representative work

- [TabbyGuard — released frontend QA tool](https://github.com/tabitha-dev/TabbyGuard)
- [MedOps — synthetic healthcare dashboard](https://tabitha-dev.github.io/Medical-Practice-Dashboard/)
- [Wearwise — weather-aware JavaScript app](https://tabitha-dev.github.io/Weather_Outfit_Assitance_v2/)
- [JARVIS — local AI voice assistant](https://github.com/tabitha-dev/jarvis-local-ai)
- [ShipLab — reviewed AI-agent experiment](https://github.com/tabitha-dev/agent-shiplab)
- [Big World — book and learning resource platform](https://code.tabitha.dev/bigworld/)

## Important distinctions

The hub includes educational simulations and experiments. Clinical and billing demos use synthetic data and are not certified production medical systems. For ShipLab, independent CI passed but native agent-recorded QA was not verified. Human review remains part of AI-assisted work. The source and current portfolio are the best references for implementation and role details.
